name: NebulaGradient
description: A raw WebGL fragment shader that layers three passes of domain-warped fbm into glowing nebula clouds with dark dust lanes over near-black space, plus an optional field of softly twinkling stars. Falls back to blurred, drifting CSS gradients when WebGL is unavailable.
a11yNotes: The canvas (or CSS fallback) is an aria-hidden decorative layer; children render above in normal flow with light, shadowed text for contrast on the dark field. The render loop stops off-screen, at speed 0, and under prefers-reduced-motion (a single static frame is drawn). GL resources are deleted on unmount and a lost context switches to the CSS fallback.

propsApi.name: color3
propsApi.description: Accent color for the brightest filaments (hex).

propsApi.name: backgroundColor
propsApi.description: Deep-space base color behind the clouds (hex).

propsApi.name: density
propsApi.description: Cloud density and detail, 0.2 (sparse wisps) to 2 (thick nebula).

propsApi.name: stars
propsApi.description: Render a subtle field of twinkling stars.

propsApi.description: Height of the background in px.
